macros.name: bitpattern
macros.doc: The \bitpattern macro is the macro which formats the patterns.

macros.name: bitpattern
macros.doc: The \bitpattern macro is the macro which formats the patterns.

macros.name: bpFormatBitNumber
macros.doc: \bpFormatBitNumber is a one argument macro used fo format the bit numbers.

macros.name: bpFormatField
macros.doc: \bpFormatField is a one argument macro used fo format the field.

macros.name: bpNoBitNumbers
macros.doc: \bpNoBitNumbers changes the default to having no numbering.

macros.name: bpNumberAllBits
macros.doc: \bpNumberAllBits changes the default to having the numbering done for all bits of a field.

macros.name: bpNumberBitsAbove
macros.doc: \bpNumberBitsAbove changes the default to having the numbering above the fields.

macros.name: bpNumberBitsBelow
macros.doc: \bpNumberBitsBelow changes the default to having the numbering below the fields.

macros.name: bpNumberFieldsOnce
macros.doc: \bpNumberFieldsOnce changes the default to having the numbering done once per field.

macros.name: bpNumberFieldsTwice
macros.doc: \bpNumberFieldsTwice changes the default to having the numbering done twice per field.

macros.name: bpSetTickHeight
macros.doc: \bpSetTickHeight gives the default height for the ticks marking the bits in a multi-bit field.
